caption: BOLD signal showing positive correlation with increasing feedback values in a priori ROIs and the amygdala ROI.
footer: pFWE, SVC indicates the p value resulting from family-wise error (FWE) small volume correction (SVC) on peak voxel activity within a priori ROIs and the amygdala ROI. T-statistics were obtained from t-tests.ns, not significant.aNo voxels within the anatomically defined VTA ROI included in the “reward mask” were significantly activated by feedback value. However, a complimentary ROI analysis using a slightly different and functionally defined VTA ROI showed that VTA BOLD signal significantly tracked feedback value (see Supplementary Note 4 for details).bThe amygdala was not part of the initial hypotheses, thus a stricter (Bonferroni-corrected) statistical threshold was applied in order to infer any involvement of the amygdala (α = 0.0167).
